R1_readings.binding: reading B; the clause is DISPUTED so both are computed and printed

rules.R3_band: buildable N in [max(20, N_min), min(34, N_max)]; empty band = no design in that cell
rules.R4_parallel: Sp_max = floor(40 / (1.25 * Isc)) strings a tracker; fuses needed when Sp >= 3 or (Sp-1)*1.25*Isc > the declared module fuse rating
rules.R5_volt_drop: volt drop pct = Imp * R / (N * Vmp * (1 + gamma/100 * (Thot - 25))) * 100 <= 1.5; R = r_lead*N*0.63 + r_site*((N-2)p + s + 2L) + (N+1)*Rc; monotone in L, so the SHORTEST home run in a band decides whether that band holds a design at all
rules.R6_wiring: conductor metres: sequential = 0.63N + (N-2)p + s + 2L; leapfrog-turned = 2.006N + 2L. Turned costs about 1.09 m of lead for every 1 m of site cable it saves, so it NEVER minimises metres; it only wins on resistance when r_lead / r_site < ((N-2)p + s) / (N * (2p - s + 0.2 - 0.63)), which at N=30, p=1.323 is 0.917 - i.e. only when the lead is a size larger than the site cable
rules.tie_break: the pack maximises N, then minimises conductor metres, then takes the largest lead size and the largest strings-in-parallel that still hold (metres do not depend on cable size, so that tie is settled by cross-section)
